native_observation: On the parent system-codec macOS application, the legacy Line Properties dialog showed Continuous for the explicit P8D_CUSTOM linetype after R12-to-2018 save and reopen. The dialog was cancelled without editing.
implementation: Entity pen dialogs now use the shared drawing-aware linetype combo. Its source pen and row identity preserve untouched custom names and permit choosing the Continuous row or another drawing type. A missing definition has a temporary named row. Contexts without a drawing retain the built-in-only selector.
verification: Offscreen system-codec GUI tests passed: 108 assertions in 7 test cases. Tests include a drawing-defined custom name, switching to Continuous and another defined name, preserving the name when changing color, a missing definition, ByLayer, and switching to a no-drawing context.
Parent PR head 750c7577 had fast, both headless, both Windows, and all five Pixi jobs passing; CodeQL was still in progress at the poll.
limitations: The modified app has not been exercised in a native GUI: the computer-use environment declined access to the new scratch app.
These results do not qualify every property dialog or layer editor, other platforms, or general named-linetype compatibility.
The earlier native observation establishes a display issue; no native edit or saved data loss was observed.
